title: Settle fileParallelism on the real CI runner: a temporary workflow_dispatch job
description:
Both re-measurements of fileParallelism (2026-09-18 on pool-workers 0.21.3: 1 failure in 5; 2026-10-07 on 0.22.0: 20 parallel runs green, ten of them under 1-minute host load 13-87) have cleared the laptop, but no laptop run can clear the 2-vCPU ubuntu runner where 5qj's corruption was actually observed. The only measurement that can flip the flag is N parallel runs on the real runner: a temporary workflow_dispatch job that runs `pnpm exec vitest run --file-parallelism` in cloudflare, say 10 times, on ubuntu-24.04, reporting each run's verdict. All green: the flag goes on with CI evidence and the serial cost (the suite's ~345 s there) is recovered; any red: the vitest.config.ts comment gains the CI date and version. The shape is already named in the comment this tick updated (cloudflare/vitest.config.ts, beside fileParallelism); this proposal makes it a tick of its own.
evidence: cloudflare/vitest.config.ts fileParallelism: false and its comment; .github/workflows/ci.yml typescript job runs `pnpm test` in cloudflare on ubuntu-24.04
